name: D K Plastics
old_description: Family-owned and headquartered in Archer, Iowa. Founded 1995. We extruded our first HDPE sheet in 1998, in a 6,000 sq ft building. As production grew, extrusion moved into a dedicated 24,000 sq ft building; vacuum thermoforming and CNC routing run from the original shop, expanded over the years.
about:
D K Plastics is a family-owned manufacturer headquartered in Archer, Iowa. The company was founded in 1995 and extruded its first HDPE sheet in 1998, starting in a 6,000-square-foot building.

Today the operation spans three product lines: heavy-gauge HDPE sheet extrusion (.060–.750 inch thick, widths to 60 inches, rolls to 500 feet, virgin or reprocessed with an FDA food-grade option), vacuum thermoforming on a single-platen press (up to 48 by 96 inches, draw depth to 14 inches), and precision CNC routing (60 by 240 inch bed). Extrusion runs in a dedicated 24,000-square-foot facility, while thermoforming and routing operate from the original shop. The company serves prototype through production volumes.

Primary customers include marine and recreational vehicle manufacturers, with the company also offering FDA food-grade HDPE for food-contact applications.

The business emphasizes in-house extrusion and finishing, allowing control over material quality and lead times from its Iowa location.
